# GSAP (vendored)

Files in this directory are the unmodified minified builds from the npm
package `gsap@3.13.0` (`dist/gsap.min.js`, `dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js`,
`dist/ScrollToPlugin.min.js`).

They are vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so the site has no
third-party runtime dependency and works behind restrictive networks.
